inference.assumptions: Independent training runs; seed set, comparisons and protocol fixed before test inspection. Distinct checkpoint paths alone do not prove independence. Tests direction consistency, not mean effect size or safety.

sft_vs_base.resource_usage_scope: Descriptive held-out rollout usage, including failed attempts. Tokens per success are null when no case succeeds. Positive deltas mean more candidate usage. Trajectory seconds sum individual latencies, not wall-clock duration. Excludes training, input tokens, provider billing and unrecorded retries; usage is not independently verified. These measurements do not change the learning or safety gates.
sft_vs_base.interpretation: Engineering gates with a conditional seed-level sign test; not production certification. Review training provenance and test isolation.
